summary: @or-sdk/billing-internal preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The npm `preinstall` script `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmod +x's the `bun` binary in a temp directory, and invokes it (via `execFileSync`) against a shipped ~727 KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` uses a rotating string-array cipher (`function WV8StW(...){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`) with hex-named identifiers and carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it is intended for the Bun runtime and does not execute under Node, so its contents are not visible to normal Node-based inspection. The advertised billing SDK sources under `dist/cjs/` and `src/` are unrelated to this payload. Fetching a second-language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled blob is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; it produces arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install` with the package directory as the working directory.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
